1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. O YHWH, in Your strength the king rejoices! And in Your salvation, how greatly he exults!

2.w: The desire of his heart You have given to him, and the request of his lips you have not withheld. Selah

3.w: for You put before him the blessings of goodness; You set upon his head a crown of pure gold.

4.w: Life he has asked from You, [and] You gave [it] to him—length of days, forever and ever.

5.w: Great [is] his glory in Your salvation; splendor and majesty You have placed upon him.

6.w: For You set [for] him blessings forever; You make him rejoice with gladness before Your face.

7.w: For the king trusts in YHWH, and in the loving devotion of the Most High he shall not be shaken.

8.w: Your hand will find all Your enemies; Your right hand will find those hating You.

9.w: You will place them as [in] a furnace of fire at the time of Your presence; YHWH in His anger will swallow them up, and the fire will devour them.

10.w: Their fruit You will destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of men.

11.w: For they stretched out against you [for] evil. They devised a plot; they will not prevail.

12.w: For You set them [to the] shoulder; You prepare Your bowstrings against their faces.

13.w: Be exalted, O YHWH, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your might.
